response.text: Invoice 1 and 801 share a base invoice number but 801 is a distinct credit memo (different reference, "-CM"), so that is not a duplicate. Invoice 285 is the only journal tie-out failure among the AP invoices. I'll confirm the 285 gap and the 647 DR-side imbalance directly.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "APINVH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."INV_ID" IN (285, 647, 801) ORDER BY h."INV_ID", l."LN_SEQ"
